--- Email Out ---
Subject: Request for Transcript Copy

Hi Registrar’s Office,

I need an unofficial transcript for my scholarship renewal. Could you please send it to me by email?

Thanks,
Grace Kim

--- Email In ---
Subject: Unofficial Transcript Request

Dear Grace,

Please find attached your unofficial transcript. Note that official copies must be requested through the online portal.

Best,
Registrar’s Office
Hillcrest University

--- Attachment ---
Hillcrest University  
Office of the Registrar  
Unofficial Transcript  
Student Name: Grace Kim  
Student ID: 00352716  
Date of Birth: 1999-08-12  
Degree Program: Bachelor of Science, Biology  
Expected Graduation Date: May 2025  

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ACADEMIC RECORD

Term: Fall 2021  
Course Code    Course Title                         Credits   Grade    Quality Points  
BIO
